Sustained Current Stand.name: Sustained Current Stand
Sustained Current Stand.description: The user stands at a connected metal barrier or cable and maintains a strong current through it for the rest of the scene, denying passage to opponents while allies evacuate elsewhere. Touching the barrier deals moderate electric damage; held back, it gives a disabling shock. Broken contact ends the current, and prolonged output brings the user close to a brain short circuit. Strain: severe.
